import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import '../styles/adlanding.css'; /* * AdLanding — where the SimAd banner redirects to. * * Stage 1 ("checkout"): a fictional-brand checkout page ("Shoppa" / * Shoppa Commerce, Inc. — not Shopee or any other real retailer). It * LOOKS like a believable "claim your voucher" membership upsell, but * no input is validated against real card rules, nothing is sent * over the network, and nothing is persisted anywhere. * * Stage 2 ("revealed"): entered only after the participant clicks * "Confirm". Immediately explains this was the simulation and walks * through the red flags, including the ones specific to a fake * checkout/payment form. */ const RED_FLAGS = [ 'Urgency and scarcity in the ad — "claim before it expires" — designed to get you clicking before you think.', 'A reward disproportionate to anything you actually did, for a voucher you never entered to win.', 'Claiming a "free" voucher somehow requires entering a full card number, expiry and CVC.', 'A believable-looking plan/pricing layout is easy to fake — visual polish is not proof a page is legitimate.', 'No way to verify you are even on the real domain for "Shoppa" — a lookalike site can be built in minutes.', ]; export default function AdLanding() { const navigate = useNavigate(); const [stage, setStage] = useState('checkout'); const [plan, setPlan] = useState('monthly'); const handleSubscribe = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); // Intentionally does nothing with the form data — it is never read, // sent, or stored. Only the stage changes. setStage('revealed'); }; if (stage === 'revealed') { return (
